newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Friday on long-liquidation, pressured by expectations that rubber stock figures to be announced next week will show a further increase, traders said.
All contracts hit their life-of-contract lows on Friday. Prices ranged from 2.0 yen to 4.1 yen per kg lower, with benchmark March ending down 2.0 at 134.5 yen.
Views that the yen's fall against the dollar will be stalled, also undermined market sentiment.
"Amid bearish sentiment, traders expect the benchmark March to fall below 130 yen next week," one trader said.
